questions.question: Clarify the exact birth-date claim: the 1136 problem gives an age of twenty-six and hence the year 1110, not a day and month. Approve year of birth in both versions and the certainty of his final life date.

localizations.source: Clarify the exact birth-date claim: the 1136 problem gives an age of twenty-six and hence the year 1110, not a day and month. Approve year of birth in both versions and the certainty of his final life date.
localizations.ru: Уточнить «дату рождения можем установить точно»: задача 1136 года о возрасте 26 лет позволяет получить год 1110, но не день и месяц. Согласовать «год рождения» в RU/EN и степень определённости конечной даты жизни.

questions.resolution: Both editions specify the birth year inferred from the problem. The life dates remain approximate.

questions.question: The calendar outline has water every 70 years followed by an orphan 14. The 14 appears to be a lost reference number and is not treated as part of the period; seventy years is retained. Supply its source and approve the no-parallel claim for the subdivisions of the hour.

localizations.source: The calendar outline has water every 70 years followed by an orphan 14. The 14 appears to be a lost reference number and is not treated as part of the period; seventy years is retained. Supply its source and approve the no-parallel claim for the subdivisions of the hour.
localizations.ru: В календарном перечне исходник содержит «Воды — каждые 70 лет 14». Отдельное 14 похоже на потерянный номер ссылки и не перенесено как часть периода; 70 лет сохранены. Нужны источник и решение об этой ссылке. Уточнить по изданию также безусловное утверждение об отсутствии аналогов деления часа.

questions.question: Approve attribution of the engraving-style illustration: the archive includes generation-style filenames but no confirmed historical original. It is not captioned as a lifetime portrait, and its decorative marks are not presented as authentic medieval notation. Supply the tool or authorship if known.
